chatgpt.description: OpenAI's conversational assistant for text, images, voice and code, in the browser and in the apps.
chatgpt.highlight: The market benchmark for AI chats: memory, custom GPTs, file analysis and voice mode.

claude.description: Anthropic's assistant focused on long conversations, writing, document analysis and code.
claude.highlight: Long context and careful answers; Claude Code brings the model straight into the terminal.

gemini.description: Google's chat powered by the Gemini models, integrated with Search, Gmail and Workspace.
gemini.highlight: Multimodal from the start and integrated into Google products; it also shows up as the Android assistant.

deepseek.description: DeepSeek's chat with open models, strong at reasoning and programming, with a free web version.
deepseek.highlight: It popularised low-cost reasoning models; the code and the weights are open.

microsoft-copilot.description: Microsoft's assistant with GPT inside Windows, Edge and Microsoft 365.
microsoft-copilot.highlight: Built into the system and the Office apps, with access to the web and work context.

perplexity.description: Answer engine with web search and citations for every claim.
perplexity.highlight: Every answer comes with sources; it is the chat for researching instead of just talking.

grok.description: xAI's assistant integrated with X (Twitter), with access to posts in real time.
grok.highlight: It answers at the pace of the timeline and has reasoning modes and image generation.

le-chat.description: Mistral AI's chat with European models, fast answers and a focus on privacy.
le-chat.highlight: A European alternative to US chats, with a free version and plans for companies.

meta-ai.description: Meta's assistant available on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and the web.
meta-ai.highlight: It reaches billions of people inside Meta's apps, with image generation and quick answers.

qwen-chat.description: Alibaba's chat with the Qwen family, including open models and image and video generation.
qwen-chat.highlight: Competitive open models and an interface with coding, image and research tools.

kimi.description: Moonshot AI's assistant known for handling documents and very long contexts.
kimi.highlight: It became known for its huge context: you can send whole books and reports into the conversation.

poe.description: Quora's platform that gathers several models and AI bots under a single subscription.
poe.highlight: One chat to try GPT, Claude, Gemini and community bots without switching sites.

huggingchat.description: Hugging Face's open source chat with open models and the option to run the interface yourself.
huggingchat.highlight: Open source end to end: you can use the service or host your own instance.
